'''Phootla Veer''', along with [[Lima Starcourt]] and [[Reebo Keen]], was one of three leaders of a separatist cell that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ostor]] and remained loyal to the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] long after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended. A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] launched a military offensive to suppress the influence of the separatists on Ostor. Veer and the other separatist leaders helped establish a defense strategy. This allowed the separatist general Atticus Farstar to almost completely wipe out a first wave of the Empire. However, the defense did not stand up to a second wave of attacks. Veer and the other leaders were killed in the course of the battle.
